We can support the suggested pattern but need the following to proceed:
1) A formal service request opened in our internal Capacity queue (ticket: CAP-XXXX) with the exact time window and ingress_profile.json attached.
2) The ingress_profile.json must include the expected 1-minute peak RPS, average token length, and whether they’ll be using streaming.

- If sustained error rate >1% or latency P95 > 1.5s for 10m, infra will auto-throttle and notify the on-call.
